full_prompt_en: A minimalist black-and-white studio photograph presents a single anonymous figure from the chest upward against an absolute black background. Fine white fabric wraps the head and shoulders, covering the face completely. The head forms a tall rounded arch near the upper center, with one long narrow vertical fold creating a recessed dark slit where facial features might otherwise appear. Another band of cloth crosses diagonally from the lower left shoulder toward the right side of the neck, then curves around the figure in generous overlapping loops. The garment pools in the lower frame as broad, sculptural folds, each ridge defined by a clean silver highlight and each recess by deep charcoal shadow. No hair, skin, eyes, or hands are visible; the image relies on drapery and posture alone. The figure is placed slightly right of center, leaving an ample black margin that makes the pale silhouette feel isolated and still. The photographic treatment is extremely controlled: sharp, legible threadlike striations run along the fabric, while tonal gradients across larger folds remain silky and continuous. One soft directional light from the upper left grazes the material, revealing its thin weave and the changing tension where cloth stretches over a hidden form. The background absorbs the shadows without any wall, horizon, or props. White, silver gray, charcoal, and black are the only tones, arranged in a clear hierarchy from illuminated outer contour to the darkest central recess. The result is quiet and enigmatic, balancing a severe graphic silhouette with the almost tactile detail of layered textile.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅极简黑白影棚照片在绝对黑色背景前呈现一名单独的匿名人物，画面取胸部以上。细白布裹住头与肩，面部完全遮住。头形在上方中央附近形成高而圆的拱形，一道细长竖向布褶在原本可能出现五官的位置形成暗凹缝。另一道布从左下肩斜穿至颈部右侧，再以宽大的重叠环绕在人物周围。衣料在下方画幅积成宽阔雕塑性褶皱，每条脊线由干净银白高光限定，每道凹处由深炭灰阴影刻出。看不到头发、皮肤、眼睛或手；画面仅依靠垂布与姿态。人物略置中央偏右，留下充裕黑边，使浅色剪影显得孤立而静止。摄影处理极为受控：纤维般细的条纹沿布料清楚延伸，大褶皱上的灰阶过渡却丝滑连续。一束从左上而来的柔和定向光擦过材料，显示薄织纹和布在隐形体积上绷紧时的变化。背景吞没阴影，没有墙面、地平线或道具。白、银灰、炭灰和黑是仅有色调，按受光外轮廓到最暗中央凹隙形成清晰层级。画面安静而神秘，在严厉的图形剪影和几乎可触的层叠织物细节之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Minimal monochrome studio photography isolates a pale sculptural form within a continuous matte-black field. Broad overlapping sheets create sweeping diagonal and curved folds, with slender recessed channels of charcoal dividing bright silver ridges. The grayscale is tightly controlled but rich: brilliant white along grazing-light edges, soft middle gray over rounded planes, and deep black in openings and surrounding space. Directional light from high to one side reveals fine linear textile texture without losing the large simple silhouette. Edges remain clean and sharply separated from the background, while internal tonal transitions flow softly across stretched and gathered surfaces. Slight off-center placement and generous empty margins make the form feel still, concentrated, and monumental. The composition gains its tension from a severe dark-light divide, the rhythm of draped curves, and the contrast between smooth broad planes and minute tactile striation.
style_prompt_zh: 极简黑白影棚摄影把浅色雕塑般形体隔离于连续哑黑底面。宽大叠压片层形成横扫的对角与弧形褶皱，狭细炭灰凹槽分开明亮银色脊线。灰阶严格受控却丰富：擦光边缘亮白，圆浑平面柔和中灰，开口和周围空间深黑。高位单侧定向光显露细线织物纹理，同时保留整体简洁大剪影。外缘与背景分得清晰锐利，内部色调却沿拉伸和收拢表面柔顺流转。略偏中心的摆位与宽裕空边使形体静止、集中且有纪念碑感。画面的张力来自严厉明暗分界、垂挂弧线的节奏，以及平滑宽面与微小可触条纹的反差。
theme_en: A white-draped anonymous figure isolated against a deep black background
theme_zh: 深黑背景中被白布覆盖面部的匿名人物
name: Nicholas Alan Cope
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
